scope.name: Designer Controls & Garment Library
in_scope: replace FDE-01 callback-only garment edit affordances with real accessible selectors, sliders, swatches and bounded layer editors matched to FGA-PARAM-1 value kinds
add governed garment-family policies and a usable provider-off catalog for silhouettes, lengths, sleeves, collars, fits, hems, closures, panels, pockets, materials, patterns, trim and palette zones
enforce FGA-PARAM-1 eligibility and family-gating for every user edit without creating a second garment authority
preserve FGA-02 topology fit diagnostics and FGA-03 reusable primitive coverage feedback as controls change
support deterministic edit/undo/redo/revert/save session behavior through the live FDE-01 Studio integration
focused cross-platform tests for controls, catalog lookup, family gating, invalid selections and provider-off behavior
out_of_scope: FDE-03 rendered garment imagery or new rendering authority
FDE-04 durable design persistence and collections
FDE-06 PAPT asset realization or paid production execution
Oaran fashion houses, eras or cultural style catalogs
Mall, marketplace, commerce or public sharing
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
